subject: How do I update our site logo on mobile?
body: Hi Support team, we noticed our website header logo looks distorted on mobile devices. Where in the admin settings can we upload a dedicated mobile logo or adjust dimensions? Thanks, David
expected_behavior: Ground response in General Settings > Brand Assets documentation.

subject: How to import vendor members via CSV spreadsheet?
body: Hello, we have a spreadsheet of 450 wedding vendors. Which columns are strictly mandatory so the import doesn't fail? Do we need subscription dates included?
expected_behavior: Cite Mandatory Fields for Member Imports and CSV file guidelines.

subject: Cancelling recurring billing for a cancelled member
body: Can an admin cancel a member's recurring monthly charge directly from the backend dashboard without logging into Stripe separately? Where is this button located?
expected_behavior: Explain Transaction History > End Subscription route.

subject: Setting up email forwarders
body: Hi, I want info@healthexperts.net to automatically forward to my personal Gmail account. How do I configure email forwarders in Brilliant Directories?
expected_behavior: Cite Emails > Email Forwarders settings guide.

subject: Importing category hierarchies
body: Can we import multi-tier categories (Top level > Sub level > Sub-sub) in a single CSV file, or do they have to be uploaded one by one?
expected_behavior: Cite How To Import Categories Via CSV File.

subject: Changing font styling and CSS stylesheets
body: Hello, our brand uses a custom Google font. Where can we safely override the theme's CSS stylesheets without losing changes during platform updates?
expected_behavior: Cite How to Override and Edit Default CSS stylesheets.

subject: Accessing Webmail directly from admin area
body: Where in the admin sidebar can our staff log into webmail to view sent contact inquiries?
expected_behavior: Cite How To Access Webmail Through the Admin Area.

subject: Connecting social media profile links
body: How do we link our organization's Instagram and LinkedIn pages so the icons appear in the website header and footer?
expected_behavior: Cite Settings > General Settings > Social Media Tab.

subject: Viewing individual member profile analytics
body: Do members have access to a dashboard that shows how many profile views and phone number clicks their listing received this month?
expected_behavior: Cite Member Profile Analytics article.

subject: Can we host a WordPress blog on the same domain?
body: We want our main directory on Brilliant Directories but our existing blog on WordPress. Is it possible to host WordPress in a subfolder or subdomain?
expected_behavior: Cite Can I host a Wordpress site on Brilliant Directories documentation.

subject: Activating post types prior to site launch
body: Should we turn on events, coupons, and classified post types right away, or is it better to leave them disabled until we have enough active members?
expected_behavior: Cite Don't Activate All Of The Post Types Prior To Website Launch.

subject: Mass email marketing campaigns
body: Can we send weekly newsletter blasts to all 10,000 members directly through the Brilliant Directories email tool, or do you recommend an external ESP?
expected_behavior: Cite Can I Send A Mass Email Campaign Using Brilliant Directories.

subject: CSV Import throws error 500 on row 142
body: Our member CSV import halts halfway through and gives a generic server error on row 142. Can you inspect what is causing this import failure?
expected_behavior: Advise checking special characters, unescaped commas, and missing mandatory fields.

subject: Stripe webhook failed: subscriptions not activating
body: When new members pay on the signup form, their credit card is charged in Stripe, but their account status remains 'Pending' on the site. Please help urgently!
expected_behavior: Guide verification of Webhook signing secret and Payment Gateway status.

subject: Custom CSS stylesheet changes disappeared after update
body: We edited the primary navigation background in the custom CSS widget, but this morning our changes seem reverted. How do we restore our custom CSS?
expected_behavior: Explain widget revision history and safe override practices.

subject: Member search filter returning 0 results for valid city
body: Users searching for 'Austin, TX' get zero results even though we have 18 verified listings located in Austin. Geocoding seems broken.
expected_behavior: Check Google Maps API key quotas and location geocoding settings.

subject: Email notifications landing in spam folders
body: Lead notification emails sent to our plumbers are going into their Junk / Spam folders in Outlook and Yahoo. How do we fix SPF/DKIM records?
expected_behavior: Provide DNS SPF/DKIM configuration instructions for domain email deliverability.

subject: Members cannot upload profile photos on mobile Safari
body: Several members report that clicking 'Upload Photo' on iPhone does nothing or freezes the page. Is there an image size limit setting?
expected_behavior: Explain file size upload settings and mobile photo orientation processing.

subject: Lead matching form not distributing to nearby breweries
body: Our 'Get a Quote' lead form received 4 submissions today, but none of the matching local businesses received an inquiry notification. Where do we check lead auto-match settings?
expected_behavior: Direct user to Lead Settings > Auto-Match rules and notification recipients.

subject: Member login loop redirecting back to home page
body: When subscribers enter correct email and password, the page reloads back to the home page instead of their member dashboard. Could this be a cookie or SSL domain issue?
expected_behavior: Troubleshoot HTTPS redirect settings and member dashboard login redirect rule.

subject: Broken image icons on member profile gallery
body: Some uploaded photos display broken image thumbnails on public profiles. Are image URLs case-sensitive or did the media folder permission change?
expected_behavior: Inspect CDN image URL formatting and member photo regeneration.

subject: SSL Certificate warning showing on checkout page
body: Chrome is showing 'Not Secure' on our membership upgrade page. How do we force full site HTTPS so customers feel safe putting in credit cards?
expected_behavior: Instruct on Admin Dashboard > Domain Manager > Install Free SSL Certificate.

subject: Project Request: Custom two-way calendar sync with Google Calendar
body: Hi, our board approved a budget to build a custom two-way sync between our directory event postings and members' individual Google Calendars. Can your engineering team build this?
expected_behavior: Acknowledge requirement, flag as custom project scope, schedule scoping call.

subject: Project Request: MLS / IDX automated real estate property feed integration
body: We want to ingest 15,000 active real estate listings daily from the regional MLS RETS/RESOD feed into our directory properties post type. Can you estimate development scope?
expected_behavior: Flag external dependency, estimate data pipeline, require human scoping.

subject: Project Request: Multi-vendor marketplace checkout with split payments
body: We need customers to buy products from multiple directory vendors in one shopping cart, with Stripe Connect splitting payments automatically between vendors and our platform fee.
expected_behavior: Identify that BD native checkout is single-merchant; flag split payment as custom microservice.

subject: Project Request: Native iOS and Android mobile app development
body: Can your team package our Brilliant Directories website into native Apple App Store and Google Play apps with push notifications for instant leads?
expected_behavior: Define scope for mobile wrapper or React Native app consuming BD API webhooks.

subject: Project Request: Video audition upload with automated transcription and tagging
body: We want actors to upload 2-minute video clips that get automatically transcribed by AI and tagged by emotion/genre. Can we scope this project with your developers?
expected_behavior: Flag AI audio/video pipeline requirement, schedule technical feasibility session.

subject: Project Request: Custom member matchmaking algorithm based on psychometrics
body: We need a 50-question quiz on onboarding that calculates compatibility scores between corporate clients and management consultants. Please prepare a scope of work.
expected_behavior: Route to Task 3 Meeting to Scope agent team.

subject: Please cancel our agency plan and process a full refund immediately
body: We were charged $299 yesterday for the annual renewal, but we stopped using the platform 3 months ago. Please cancel our plan and refund the $299 to our credit card.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge cancellation request, state policy, never promise unauthorized refunds without billing approval.

subject: Cancellation of Add-On License
body: We no longer need the VIP Member Export Add-On ($45/mo). Please remove this add-on from our monthly invoice starting next billing cycle.
expected_behavior: Confirm add-on deactivation process, ensure billing team verifies.

subject: Accidental double charge on setup fee - refund request
body: Our credit card statement shows two identical charges of $150 on October 15th for our site setup. Can you review transaction logs and refund the duplicate charge?
expected_behavior: Escalate to finance team with transaction IDs, do not issue autonomous financial commitment.

subject: Cancel subscription before 30-day money-back guarantee expires
body: I signed up 14 days ago. Under your 30-day money-back policy, I am requesting a full cancellation and refund of my $97 initial payment.
expected_behavior: Route to accounts manager with signup date verification.

subject: Immediate account termination
body: Our business is closing down operations at the end of this month. Please terminate our website hosting and delete stored customer credit card details.
expected_behavior: Provide formal cancellation confirmation checklist and data retention disclosure.

subject: Dispute over unapplied coupon discount
body: I had a 20% promotional coupon code 'AUTUMN20' that failed at checkout, charging me full price. Please credit back the $40 difference.
expected_behavior: Inspect coupon configuration and refer to billing representative.

subject: URGENT COMPLAINT: Directory search down during marketing campaign
body: We spent $5,000 on Google Ads today and our search results page has been throwing a 502 Bad Gateway for 3 hours! We are losing hundreds of qualified patient leads. Who is responsible for this?
expected_behavior: Empathetic de-escalation, immediate high-priority server triage, supervisor notification.

subject: Unacceptable support delay - Ticket #4092 still unresolved
body: I submitted a critical ticket 4 business days ago regarding member payment webhooks and have received nothing but automated robot replies. I demand a phone call with a senior manager today.
expected_behavior: Apologize for delay, locate Ticket #4092, escalate to support team lead.

subject: Platform update altered our custom header without warning
body: Your software update last night broke our custom menu navigation and logo alignment. Our corporate sponsors are complaining. Please rollback whatever code was pushed.
expected_behavior: Investigate CSS/widget version diffs and assist in restoring customized navigation widget.

subject: Spam bots flooding our member inquiry forms
body: Over 200 fake Russian casino leads were submitted through our contact form today. Why isn't Google reCAPTCHA blocking these? Our members are furious.
expected_behavior: Guide reCAPTCHA v3 setup, spam blacklist keywords, and honeypot field settings.

subject: Extremely slow page load times hurting our SEO rankings
body: Google PageSpeed Insights gives our directory home page a score of 24 on mobile. TTFB is over 3.2 seconds. This is unacceptable for a paid hosting service.
expected_behavior: Provide performance optimization checklist (image compression, disabling unused widgets, CDN cache).

subject: Broken CSV export corrupted our member phone numbers
body: We exported our members yesterday and all leading zeros in UK phone numbers were stripped by the exporter! This broke our automated SMS broadcaster.
expected_behavior: Explain Excel CSV auto-formatting vs plain text export and text column formatting tips.

subject: Quote Request: Cost to redesign directory homepage and hero search
body: Hi, what would your agency charge to build a modern homepage design with interactive category icon cards and a centered search bar matching our Figma file?
expected_behavior: Provide hourly consulting rates ($125/hr), request Figma URL, schedule design discovery.

subject: Quote Request: Custom Zapier integration to Airtable CRM
body: How much does it cost to set up automated webhooks connecting Brilliant Directories new member signups and lead inquiries directly into our Airtable database?
expected_behavior: Estimate standard webhook setup (3-5 engineering hours), provide estimate range.

subject: Quote Request: Database migration from WordPress GeoDirectory
body: We have 12,000 doctor listings on an old WordPress GeoDirectory site. Can you provide an estimate for data sanitization, field mapping, and importing into BD?
expected_behavior: Provide migration estimate framework (10-18 hours depending on schema complexity).

subject: Quote Request: Custom gamified profile completion progress bar
body: We want an animated progress widget on the member dashboard that awards badges when members upload their bio, avatar, and social links. What is the estimated cost?
expected_behavior: Assess frontend widget development scope and provide 3-point estimate.

subject: Quote Request: Twilio SMS lead instant alerts
body: What would it cost to develop an instant SMS alert module using Twilio that texts local contractors whenever a consumer submits a roofing or plumbing lead?
expected_behavior: Explain native Webhook / Zapier options vs custom Twilio microservice and quote accordingly.

subject: Follow-up on Ticket #3819 - Custom domain DNS propagation
body: Hi, following up on our ticket from yesterday. Cloudflare A-records have been pointed to your IP for 24 hours now. Can you confirm if SSL is now active?
expected_behavior: Check domain status in Admin Dashboard, confirm SSL propagation check steps.

subject: Checking status of our proposal for custom search filter
body: Hello, we sent over our meeting notes last Thursday regarding multi-city radius filtering. Have your solutions architects finished the scope and hourly estimate?
expected_behavior: Confirm proposal under executive review, reference Task 3 Meeting to Scope deliverable.

subject: Did you receive our member CSV file for bulk import?
body: Hi team, I emailed our cleaned 800-row artisan CSV spreadsheet on Tuesday. Just checking if you received it and when the import run will be executed.
expected_behavior: Confirm receipt, cite import checklist, advise verification in sandbox.

subject: Follow-up: Staging site access credentials
body: Hi, following our kickoff call, when will our team receive the login credentials to the development sandbox environment?
expected_behavior: Provide onboarding timeline for staging environment provisioning.

body: Hi, we wired payment for the annual custom development retainer on Monday. Could accounting send us the receipt and confirm the retainer hours are active?
